blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: KV cache memory has become a major deployment bottleneck for video generation and world models, which motivates low-bit quantization study for efficiency. Existing 2-bit KV cache quantization methods can achieve nearly lossless performance on conventional video benchmarks such as VBench, however, we find that they still cause severe temporal flickering and visual degradation. Meanwhile, deeper investigates show that Key quantization produces smaller reconstruction errors than Value, but surprisingly leads to much larger output degradation. We trace this discrepancy to attention: small Key perturbations can change the attention logits, i.e. , QK ⊤ , and shift the temporal-spatial tokens selected by Queries. These observations motivate us to explicitly preserve attention logits and temporal-spatial token selection during KV cache quantization to alleviate the visual degradation problem. To address this issue, we present Quant WM , a training-free and strictly causal 2-bit KV cache quantization framework. Quant WM introduces two complementary techniques to mitigate the attention shifts. Firstly, quantization-sensitivity-aware clustering (QSAC) jointly considers historical Query sensitivity and residual ranges to select INT2-friendly Key centroids, which reduces quantization errors in channels that are more critical to attention. In addition, principal-subspace attention compensation (PSAC) restores the remaining Key errors along the dominant Query subspace using low-rank projections, which provides a direct and efficient correction to stabilize attention logits. Extensive experiments on Causal-Forcing, LingBot-World-v2, HY-World 1.5, Matrix-Game-2 and Longcat-Video demonstrate that Quant WM significantly improves visual quality and temporal consistency, while outperforming existing methods across image and video quality metrics with up to 6.20 × 6.20\times KV cache memory compression and limited additional overhead. The project page is at https://quantwm-project.github.io/QuantWM/ .

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Recent advances in video generation ( Weissenborn et al., 2019 ; Singer et al., 2022 ; Zheng et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2025b ) have achieved increasingly realistic and temporally consistent visual synthesis, while video world models ( Alonso et al., 2024 ; Xiao et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) further extend these capabilities to interactive world simulation conditioned on user actions and camera trajectories. In causal and autoregressive generation ( Huang et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026 ) , the KV cache stores historical Key and Value representations, which allows each generating chunk to efficiently attend to generated visual context without repeatedly recomputing the entire history. However, the large number of spatial-temporal tokens makes the KV cache extremely memory-intensive and becomes a major bottleneck for practical deployment. For example, LingBot-World-v2 ( Gao et al., 2026 ) requires more than 21 GB of KV cache memory to generate a 5-second video (about 93 frames), which significantly limits deployment on memory-constrained devices.
blocks.zh: 视频生成的最新进展(Weissenborn等人,2019年;Singer等人,2022年;Zheng等人,2024年;Yang等人,2025年b),实现了越来越现实和时间上一致的视觉合成,而视频世界模型(Alonso等人,2024年;Xiao等人,2026年;Wang等人,2026年)进一步将这些能力扩展到以用户动作和相机轨迹为条件的交互式世界模拟. KV缓存存储了历史密钥和价值表示,使每个生成块能够高效地处理生成的视觉上下文,而不反复重现整个历史。 然而,大量的空间时空符使KV缓存具有极高的内存密集性,成为实际部署的一个主要瓶颈. 例如,LingBot-World-v2(Gao等人,2026年)需要超过21GB的KV缓存内存才能生成5秒的视频(约93帧),这大大限制了内存约束设备的部署.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Existing 2-bit KV cache quantization methods achieve nearly lossless video performance but ignore temporal flickering and visual degradation. Quant WM effectively improves temporal consistency and significantly reduce the KV cache memory for video generation and world models.
blocks.zh: 图1:现有2位KV缓存量化方法实现近乎无损失的视频性能,但忽略了时间闪烁和视觉退化. Quant WM有效提高了时间一致性,并大大减少了用于视频生成和世界模型的KV缓存内存.

blocks.en: Quantization ( Frantar et al., 2022 ; Lin et al., 2024 ; Xiao et al., 2023 ; Zhao et al., 2024 ) is an effective model compression technique which represents high-precision tensors with low-bit values. For KV caches, quantization directly reduces the storage cost of cached Keys and Values, and has achieved promising results in large language models ( Liu et al., 2024b ; Hooper et al., 2024 ; Lin et al., 2025 ) . Particularly, recent methods can compress KV caches to 2-bit or lower with limited performance degradation ( Zhang et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2025 ) . Building on these advances, Quant-VideoGen (QVG) ( Xi et al., 2026 ) extends 2-bit KV cache quantization to autoregressive video generation and shows considerable memory savings with nearly lossless performance on video benchmarks, such as VBench ( Huang et al., 2024b ) .
blocks.zh: 量子化(Frantar 等人,2022年;Lin等人,2024年;Xiao等人,2023年;Zhao等人,2024年)是一种有效的模型压缩技术,它代表了具有低位值的高精度载荷. 对于KV缓存,量化直接降低了缓存的密钥和值的存储成本,并在大语言模型中取得了有希望的成果(Liu等人,2024b;Hooper等人,2024;Lin等人,2025). 特别是,最近的方法可以压缩KV缓存到2位或更低,但性能退化有限(Zhang等人,2024年;Li等人,2025年)。 在这些进步的基础上,Quant-VideoGen(QVG)(Xi等人,2026年)将2位KV缓存量化为自旋式视频生成,并显示出相当可观的内存节约,在视频基准上几乎无损失的性能,如V Bench(Huang等人,2024年b).

blocks.en: Although previous methods achieve strong video benchmark performance, we discover an overlooked failure of 2-bit KV cache quantization video generation and world models. As shown in Figure 1 , the quantized videos exhibit clear visual degradation compared with BF16, including temporal flickering, blurring, and artifacts, which are not fully captured by video benchmarks even when their reported scores remain nearly unchanged. This unexpected discrepancy motivates us to further investigate where the degradation comes from. We first disentangle the effects of Key and Value quantization and find that the degradation is mainly caused by Keys , where quantizing Keys alone leads to much worse visual quality than quantizing Values. More unexpectedly, Keys themselves exhibit smaller quantization errors than Values but cause larger output errors. This phenomenon indicates that the sensitivity of Keys cannot be explained by quantization error magnitude alone ( Tuncer et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 虽然以前的方法实现了强大的视频基准性能,但我们发现了2位KV缓存量化视频生成和世界模型被忽略的失败. 如图1所示,与BF16相比,被量化的视频呈现明显的视觉退化,包括时间闪烁、模糊和文物,即使其报告得分几乎没有变化,视频基准也没有完全记录这些视频。 这种意想不到的差异促使我们进一步调查退化的根源。 我们首先解析了Key和Value四分法的影响,发现退化主要是Keys造成的,仅对Keys进行四分法就会导致比对价值进行四分法更糟糕的视觉质量. 更出乎意料的是,Keys本身显示出比Values更小的量化错误,但会导致更大的输出错误. 这种现象表明,单靠量化误差级无法解释Keys的灵敏度(Tuncer等人,2026年).

blocks.en: To understand this challenge, we revisit the attention computation in Transformers. Keys determine the matching scores between Queries and cached tokens through Q ​ K ⊤ QK^{\top} . Therefore, even small perturbations to Keys can alter attention logits and change the ranking of temporal-spatial tokens, which may cause frequent token-selection shifts . Such shifts will redirect Queries to incorrect cached frames or spatial regions, which leads to temporal flickering and visual degradation.
blocks.zh: 为了理解这个挑战,我们重新审视了"变形金刚"中的注意力计算. Keys通过QKQQQQTop}确定查询和缓存符之间的匹配分数. 因此,即使对Keys的微小扰动也能改变注意力记录,改变时空空间标志的排名,这可能导致经常的令牌选择班次. 这种转变将使查询转向不正确的缓存框架或空间区域,从而导致时间闪烁和视觉退化。

blocks.en: Based on these insights, we propose Quant WM , a training-free 2-bit KV cache quantization framework that preserves attention behavior during quantization. Specifically, we first introduce quantization-sensitivity-aware clustering (QSAC) , which builds on the centroid-residual quantization scheme of QVG and reduces the impact of Key quantization errors on attention logits. Instead of selecting centroids according to K-means clustering ( McQueen, 1967 ) , QSAC jointly considers Query sensitivity and the dynamic range of the K residuals to select centroids with smaller INT2 residual quantization impact on Q ​ K ⊤ QK^{\top} . Secondly, to further correct the attention shifts, we introduce principal-subspace attention compensation (PSAC) to directly compensate the attention logits during inference. In detail, PSAC extracts the dominant Query subspace and represents the remaining Key error components along these sensitive directions with low-rank projections.
blocks.zh: 基于这些洞察力,我们提出Quant WM,一个免费的2位KV缓存量子化框架,在量子化过程中保留关注行为. 具体地说,我们首先引入了量化-敏感-感知集群(QSAC),它建立在QVG的中间行星-剩余定量计划中,并降低了关键量化错误对注意力记录的影响. QSAC没有按照K-means群集(McQueen,1967年)来选择百分行星,而是联合考虑 查询敏感性和K残基的动态范围,以选择对Q K QQKQQQTop 产生较小的INT2残基量化影响的百人机器人. 第二,为了进一步纠正注意力转移,我们引入主要-子空间注意力补偿(PSAC),在推断时直接补偿注意力记录. 详细来说,PSAC提取了占主导地位的Query子空间,并代表了这些敏感方向上剩余的带有低级预测的密钥错误组件.

blocks.en: We conduct extensive experiments on diverse representative world models and video generation models, including LingBot-World-v2 ( Gao et al., 2026 ) , Matrix-Game-2 ( He et al., 2025 ) , LongCat-Video ( Team et al., 2025 ) , HY-World 1.5 ( Sun et al., 2025 ) and Causal-Forcing ( Huang et al., 2026 ) . The results show that Quant WM consistently alleviates the temporal flickering and visual degradation, while maintaining strong performance on VBench. Meanwhile, Quant WM achieves up to 6.20 × 6.20\times KV cache memory compression with only limited inference overhead, which demonstrates its effectiveness and efficiency for KV cache quantization in video generation and world models.
blocks.zh: 我们广泛试验了多种有代表性的世界模型和视频生成模型,包括LingBot-World-v2(Gao等人,2026年),Matrix-Game-2(He等人,2025年),Long。 猫影 (Team等人,2025年),HY-World 1.5(Sun等人,2025年)和Causal-Forcing(Huang等人,2026年). 结果显示,Quant WM持续缓解时间闪烁和视觉退化,同时保持V Bench的强性能. 同时,Quant WM实现最多6.20×6.20\times KV缓存内存压缩,只使用有限的推论间接费用,这显示了其在视频生成和世界模型中KV缓存量化的有效性和效率.

blocks.en: 3 Motivation
blocks.zh: 3 动机

blocks.en: 3.1 The Overlooked Visual Degradation under 2-Bit KV Quantization
blocks.zh: 3.1 在2-Bit KV量化下被忽略的视觉退化

blocks.en: Existing 2-bit KV cache quantization methods report nearly lossless performance on video benchmarks such as VBench. However, we find that these metrics do not fully reflect the degradation introduced by aggressive KV quantization. As shown in Figure 1 , compared with the BF16 baseline, existing 2-bit KV quantization methods produce noticeable temporal flickering, blurring, and visual artifacts. These observations suggest that video benchmarks alone may overlook important visual degradation introduced by low-bit KV cache quantization. Therefore, we further investigate which component of the KV cache is mainly responsible for this degradation.
blocks.zh: 现有的2位KV缓存量化方法在V Bench等视频基准上报告几乎无损失的性能. 然而,我们发现,这些衡量标准并没有充分反映激进的KV量化带来的降解。 如图1所示,与BF16基线相比,现有的2位KV量化方法产生了明显的时间闪烁、模糊和视觉文物。 这些观察表明,光是视频基准可能忽略了低位KV缓存量化所带来的重要的视觉退化. 因此,我们进一步调查KV缓存中哪些部分是造成这种退化的主要原因。

blocks.zh: 3.2 密钥量化 支配视觉退化

blocks.en: To locate the main source of visual degradation, we separately quantize the Key and Value caches using QVG. As shown in Figure 2 , K2V16 produces much more severe visual degradation than K16V2. On these samples, the same trend is reflected by frame-level image quality metrics in Table 2 , where K16V2 achieves clearly better PSNR, SSIM and LPIPS than K2V16, while K2V2 performs similarly to K2V16. These results indicate that the degradation of 2-bit KV cache quantization is mainly dominated by Key quantization.
blocks.zh: 为了定位视觉退化的主要来源,我们用QVG对密钥和值缓存分别进行定量. 如图2所示,K2V16产生比K16V2更严重的视觉降解. 在这些样本上,同样的趋势也体现在表2的帧级图像质量度量表上,其中K16V2比K2V16明显地实现了更好的PSNR,SSIM和LPIPS,而K2V2的性能与K2V16类似. 这些结果表明,2位KV缓存量化的降解主要是Key量化.

blocks.en: More surprisingly, as shown in Table 1 , the reconstruction error of quantized Keys is even smaller than that of Values, while K2V16 introduces a larger output error than K16V2. This suggests that the sensitivity of Keys cannot be explained by the magnitude of their quantization error.
blocks.zh: 更令人惊讶的是,如表1所示,量化键的重建错误甚至比值小,而K2V16引入了比K16V2更大的输出错误. 这表明Keys的灵敏度不能以其量化错误的严重程度来解释.

blocks.en: 3.3 Key Quantization Perturbs Temporal-Spatial Token Selection
blocks.zh: 3.3 关键值量化 临时空间托肯选择

(5) Therefore, even a small Key perturbation may change the relative ordering of attention logits and shift the temporal-spatial tokens selected by Queries.

blocks.en: To validate this analysis, we further visualize the temporal-spatial tokens selected by Queries. As shown in Figure 3 , 2-bit Key quantization causes clear token-selection shifts compared with BF16, where Queries attend to different historical frames or spatial regions. At the visual level, such shifts will lead to temporal flickering and blurring in the generated videos. This attention mismatch explains why smaller Key quantization error can still lead to larger output degradation compared with Value. Accordingly, in addition to minimize K reconstruction error, KV cache quantization should also consider to reduce its impact on attention logits and temporal-spatial token selection.
blocks.zh: 为了验证这一分析,我们进一步直观化了查询所选择的时间-空间符号. 如图3所示,2位键的量化导致与BF16相比的符号选择变化明显,其中查询处理不同的历史框架或空间区域. 在视觉方面,这种转变将导致产生视频的时间闪烁和模糊。 这种关注不匹配解释了为什么较小的密钥量化错误仍然会导致与值相比更大的输出退化. 因此,除了尽量减少K重建错误之外,KV缓存的量化还应考虑减少其对注意力记录和时空符号选择的影响。

blocks.en: 4 Quant WM
blocks.zh: 4 量子 WM

blocks.en: In this section, we present Quant WM , a training-free 2-bit KV cache quantization framework for video generation and world models. We first introduce quantization-sensitivity-aware clustering (QSAC) to reduce the impact of Key quantization on attention logits. And then we present principal-subspace attention compensation (PSAC) to further correct the attention shifts.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们介绍了Quant WM,一个用于视频生成和世界模型的免费2位KV缓存量化框架. 我们首先采用量化-敏感-感知集群(QSAC),以减少键量化对注意力记录的影响. 然后我们提出主要-子空间注意力补偿(PSAC)来进一步纠正注意力转移.

blocks.en: 4.1 Quantization-Sensitivity-Aware Clustering (QSAC)
blocks.zh: 4.1 量化-敏感性-智能集群(QSAC)

blocks.en: Existing centroid-residual KV quantization methods (QVG) typically apply K-means to assign each Key token to its nearest centroid and then quantizing the residual tensor. Such a strategy mainly considers the distance between tokens and centroids but ignores the impact of the quantized residual. As discussed in Section 3 , even a small Key quantization error may cause large perturbations to attention logits when it interacts with sensitive Query channels. To address this issue, we introduce QSAC, which selects centroids based on the impact of residual quantization on attention logits. Specifically, it jointly considers Query-channel sensitivity and the dynamic range of residual groups so that it can introduce smaller quantization perturbations to Q ​ K ⊤ QK^{\top} .

blocks.zh: 5 实验

blocks.en: 5.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 实验设置

blocks.en: To validate the effectiveness of Quant WM on alleviating visual degradation, we conduct extensive experiments on five open-sourced autoregressive video generation and world models, including LongCat-Video ( Team et al., 2025 ) , HY-World 1.5 ( Sun et al., 2025 ) , LingBot-World-v2 ( Gao et al., 2026 ) , Matrix-Game-2 ( He et al., 2025 ) and Causal-Forcing ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) . We conduct the main evaluation at 480 480 p and 720 720 p generate videos with 93 frames.
blocks.zh: 为验证Quant WM在缓解视觉退化方面的有效性,我们对5个开源自递式视频生成和世界模型进行了广泛的实验,包括LongCat-Video(Team等人,2025年),HY-World 1.5(Sun等人,2025年),Ling. Bot-World-v2(Gao等人,2026年),Matrix-Game-2(He等人,2025年)和Causal-Forcing(Zhu等人,2026年). 我们以480 480页和720 720页进行主要评估,生成93帧的视频。

blocks.en: We mainly evaluate the visual degradation introduced by KV cache quantization using frame-level image quality metrics, including PSNR, SSIM and LPIPS. As discussed in Section 3 , these metrics provide a more direct measurement of the visual distortions caused by quantization. During experiments, we compute them over all frames of each video. We also report performance on VBench ( Huang et al., 2024b ) , including Background Consistency, Subject Consistency, Imaging Quality, and Aesthetic Quality. Although it may not fully capture the visual degradation studied in this work, it is still an important benchmark for evaluating the overall quality of generated videos.
blocks.zh: 我们主要评价KV缓存量化采用的视觉降解,使用帧级图像质量度量,包括PSNR,SSIM和LPIPS. 如第3节所述,这些衡量标准更直接地衡量量化造成的视觉扭曲。 在实验中,我们计算每个视频的所有帧。 我们还报告了关于V Bench(Huang等人,2024年b)的业绩,包括背景一致性、主题一致性、成像质量和审美质量。 虽然它可能没有完全捕捉到本作中研究的视觉退化,但它仍然是评价生成的视频整体质量的重要基准.

blocks.en: We select Quant VideoGen ( Xi et al., 2026 ) , the most relevant 2-bit KV cache quantization method for video generation, as the main baseline. To provide additional low-bit baselines, we also include KIVI ( Liu et al., 2024b ) into comparison which is the representative LLMs KV cache quantization method. Following QVG, we use the prompt suite from MovieGen Benchmark ( Polyak et al., 2024 ) . 1 1 1 facebookresearch/MovieGenBench For Matrix-Game-2 which does not accept text inputs, we use the 29 official first-frame images where each image is combined with 7--8 different action sequences as inputs. 2 2 2 SkyworkAI/Matrix-Game/tree/main/Matrix-Game-2/demo_images . For fair comparison, we reproduce all the baselines with their official repository, follow the native KV cache convention of each model and apply all methods to the same cached tensors.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we investigate the overlooked visual degradation caused by KV cache quantization in video generation and world models. We show that Key quantization is more sensitive than Value because Key perturbations can influence attention logits and shift temporal-spatial token selection. Based on this observation, we propose Quant WM , a training-free 2-bit KV cache quantization framework that considers attention preservation. Quant WM includes quantization-sensitivity-aware clustering (QSAC), which incorporates Query sensitivity and residual quantization difficulty into centroid selection, and principal-subspace attention compensation (PSAC), which directly corrects the remaining logit perturbations along dominant Query directions. Experiments across multiple video generation and world models demonstrate that Quant WM effectively alleviates temporal flickering and visual degradation while maintaining high KV cache compression.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们调查了KV缓存在视频生成和世界模型中量化导致的被忽视的视觉退化. 我们显示,密钥量化比价值更敏感,因为密钥扰动可以影响注意力对数并改变时空符号选择. 基于这一观察,我们提出Quant WM,一个训练免费的2位KV缓存量化框架,考虑注意保留. 量子WM包括定量敏感感知集群(QSAC),该集群将精度敏感度和剩余量子化难度纳入到中间行星选择中,主子空间注意力补偿(PSAC),它直接按照主流的查询方向纠正剩余的对数扰动. 跨越多个视频生成和世界模型的实验表明,Quant WM在保持高KV缓存压缩的同时,有效缓解了时间闪烁和视觉退化.

blocks.en: A.1 Video Generation and World Models
blocks.zh: A.1 视频生成和世界模式

blocks.en: Diffusion-based video generation has advanced rapidly through large-scale spatial-temporal Transformers, which significantly improves visual fidelity and temporal consistency ( Singer et al., 2022 ; Zheng et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2025b ) . Recent autoregressive approaches further enable long-form and streaming generation by producing videos chunk by chunk under causal attention ( Huang et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026 ; Zhu et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2025a ) . Building on these advances, video world models incorporate action and camera controls to support real-time interaction with generated environments ( Alonso et al., 2024 ; He et al., 2025 ; Gao et al., 2026 ; Valevski et al., 2025 ) . Long-term consistency has also motivated explicit memory mechanisms that retrieve or reconstruct relevant historical observations ( Xiao et al., 2026 ; Sun et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) . Nevertheless, causal video models commonly storage historical representations through KV caches. Since each generated chunk introduces numerous spatial-temporal tokens, the cache grows rapidly with the cached context and will finally dominate GPU memory, making KV cache efficiency a central bottleneck for video generation and world modeling.
blocks.zh: 基于传播的视频生成通过大规模空间时空变换器快速推进,显著提高了视觉的忠诚度和时间一致性(Singer等人,2022年;郑等人,2024年;杨等人,2025年b). 近期的自动递减方法通过制作因果注意的逐块视频,进一步使长形和流体生成成为可能(黄等人,2026年;刘等人,2026年;朱等人,2026年;杨等人,2025年a). 在这些进展的基础上,视频世界模型纳入了行动和相机控制,以支持与生成环境的实时互动(Alonso等人,2024年;He等人,2025年;Gao等人,2026年;Valevski等人,2025年)。 长期一致性也激发了检索或重建相关历史观测的明确记忆机制(萧等人,2026年;孙等人,2025年;王等人,2026年). 尽管如此,因果视频模型通常通过KV缓存存储历史表现. 由于每个生成的块引入了众多的空间-时空符,缓存随缓存上下文迅速增长,最终将主导GPU内存,使得KV缓存效率成为视频生成和世界建模的中心瓶颈.

blocks.en: A.2 Model Quantization
blocks.zh: A.2 模式量化

blocks.en: Quantization ( Nagel et al., 2020 ; Liu et al., 2024a ) reduces storage and inference overheads by transfer high-precision tensors to low-bit values. Post-training quantization ( Shao et al., 2024 ; Huang et al., 2024a ; Zhao et al., 2025a ) has become particularly attractive because it avoids costly model retraining. Representative methods include GPTQ ( Frantar et al., 2022 ) , which uses approximate second-order information for weight reconstruction, SmoothQuant ( Xiao et al., 2023 ) , which migrates activation outliers into weights for W8A8 quantization, and AWQ ( Lin et al., 2024 ) , which protects activation-salient weight channels. These methods primarily focus on efficient inference by compressing model weights and activations.
blocks.zh: 量子化(Nagel等人,2020年;Liu等人,2024a)通过将高精度的变位器转移到低位值来减少存储和推论的间接费用. 培训后量化(Shao等人,2024年;Huang等人,2024年a;Zhao等人,2025年a)由于避免了昂贵的模式再培训,因此变得特别有吸引力。 代表性方法包括GPTQ(Frantar等人,2022年),使用近似二阶信息进行体重重建,SmoothQuant(Xiao等人,2023年),将激活的离子迁移到W8A8量子化的重量,以及AWQ(Lin等人,2024年),保护激活-稳重通道. 这些方法主要通过压缩模型重量和激活来注重高效推论.

blocks.en: KV cache quantization further reduces the memory accumulated during autoregressive inference. KIVI ( Liu et al., 2024b ) applies asymmetric 2-bit quantization to Keys and Values, while KVQuant ( Hooper et al., 2024 ) introduces pre-RoPE Key quantization, non-uniform datatypes, and outlier isolation. CommVQ ( Li et al., 2025 ) instead compresses KV caches using RoPE-compatible learned codebooks. These methods mainly target language models. More recently, Quant-VideoGen (QVG) ( Xi et al., 2026 ) extends 2-bit KV cache quantization to autoregressive video diffusion through semantic-aware smoothing and residual quantization, which achieves nearly lossless performance on video benchmarks. However, we find that such benchmark-level results ignores severe temporal flickering and visual artifacts. Recent work ( Tuncer et al., 2026 ) discovers a softmax attention bias introduced by quantized Keys and corrects it at the attention-score level. In contrast, we focus on quantization perturbations of Q ​ K ⊤ QK^{\top} and temporal-spatial token selection, and address them through Query-sensitive centroid assignment and principal-subspace error compensation to improve temporal consistency.
blocks.zh: KV缓存量化进一步减少自旋推论中积累的内存. KIVI (Liu et al., 2024b )对键和值应用不对称的2位量化,而KVQuant (Hooper et al., 2024 )引入了ROPE键前的量化,非单数数据类型,以及离子隔离. CommVQ(Li et al.,2025)转而使用RoPE兼容的学习代码集压缩KV缓存. 这些方法主要针对语言模型. 最近,Quant-VideoGen(QVG)(Xi等人,2026年)通过语义感知平滑和余量化,将2位KV缓存量化延伸至自旋式视频传播,在视频基准上实现了近乎无损的性能. 然而,我们发现,这种基准层面的结果忽视了严重的时间闪烁和视觉文物。 近期的作品(Tuncer等人,2026年)发现了用量子化键引入的软马克思注意力偏差,并在注意力分数层面对其进行纠正. 相比之下,我们侧重于Q K QK QQ Top 的量化扰动和时间-空间符号选择,并通过精密的心形行星分配和主子空间误差补偿来解决,以提高时间一致性.

blocks.en: We further evaluate Quant WM under 1-minute long-horizon video generation. Long-form autoregressive generation is particularly challenging for low-bit KV cache quantization, since quantization perturbations can accumulate over successive generation steps and lead to larger deviations from the BF16 trajectory. Threfore, we focus on the overall video quality measured by VBench in this setting. As shown in Table 8 , Quant WM consistently outperforms QVG in the average VBench score across all five models. The improvement is particularly clear on HY-World 1.5, where the average score increases from 0.5949 0.5949 to 0.6627 0.6627 . Overall, Quant WM maintains strong video quality even under longer generation horizons, which demonstrates better robustness to accumulated quantization errors.

blocks.en: C.3 Initialization of Historical Query Statistics
blocks.zh: C.3 历史查询统计的初始化

blocks.en: At the beginning of generation, historical Query statistics are not available. To handle this cold-start stage without introducing unreliable estimates, we adopt a simple causal initialization strategy. For the first cache chunk, QSAC assigns uniform channel sensitivity, i.e., w h , c = 1 w_{h,c}=1 , such that centroid selection depends only on the residual quantization characteristics, while PSAC is temporarily inactive because no reliable principal Query subspace can be approximated. After the current chunk is quantized, its Query observations are incorporated into the historical second-order statistics and become available to subsequent chunks. In this way, the statistics used by QSAC and PSAC are always constructed from previously generated content, which preserve strict causality throughout inference. Since each committed chunk contributes a large number of spatial Query tokens, the historical statistics can be established rapidly after initialization without requiring an additional calibration stage or manually designed warm-up schedule.
blocks.zh: 元代初,历史查询统计不详. 为了在不引入不可靠的估计的情况下处理这个冷启动阶段,我们采取了简单的因果初始化战略. 对于第一个缓存块,QSAC指定了统一的通道灵敏度,即w h,c = 1 w_{h,c}=1,因此,百分点选择只取决于剩余量化特性,而PSAC则暂时不活动,因为没有可靠的主查询子空间可以近似. 在对当前块进行定量后,其查询观测数据被纳入历史第二顺序统计,并可供后续块使用。 这样,QSAC和PSAC使用的统计数据总是根据以前生成的内容构建的,这在整个推论中保持了严格的因果关系. 由于每个承诺块都贡献了大量的空间查询符,因此在初始化后可以快速建立历史统计,而不需要额外的校准阶段或手动设计的热量表.

blocks.en: Appendix D Efficient Algorithm-System Codesign
blocks.zh: 附录D 算法系统代号

blocks.en: D.1 Implementation Details
blocks.zh: D.1 执行细节

blocks.en: Figure 9 illustrates how our Quant WM integrates cache compression, packed storage and on-demand reconstruction into streaming inference.
blocks.zh: 图9说明了我们的Quant WM如何将缓存压缩,包装存储和按需重建纳入流推论.

blocks.en: At each native cache-chunk boundary, Quant WM replaces the completed BF16 chunk with its packed representation and releases the original storage. The active chunk remains in BF16 until completion, while historical chunks remain compressed between attention calls. To support online QSAC and PSAC, we incrementally maintain per-head Query statistics and compute the principal basis at chunk boundaries without retaining historical Query tensors.
blocks.zh: 在每个本地缓存-圆形边界上,Quant WM用其包装的表示器替换完成的BF16块,并释放原始存储. 活动块保留在BF16中直到完成,而历史块则在注意力召唤之间保持压缩. 为了支持在线的QSAC和PSAC,我们逐渐保持每头查询统计,并在不保留历史查询人数的情况下计算块边界的主要依据.

blocks.en: We physically pack four INT2 residual codes into each byte and store centroid assignments as uint8 indices. The zero-points are also bit-packed as INT2, while group scales use INT8 codes with a shared FP16 secondary scale. Each INT8 PSAC coefficient row has an FP16 scale. We retain a quantized correction only when it reduces the approximated Query-weighted error; otherwise, its coefficient row is set to zero. For each cache chunk, we select the smaller of dense and sparse coefficient layouts, including the storage cost of sparse indices.
blocks.zh: 我们把四个INT2剩余代码 输入到每个字节和存储的 中心机器人任务中 作为int8指数。 零点也是作为INT2进行比特包装,而分组比例则使用具有共享FP16二级比例的INT8代码. 每个INT8PSAC系数行都有FP16比例. 我们只保留一个定量的校正,当它减小了大致的Query加权误差;否则,它的系数行被设定为零. 对于每一个缓存块,我们选择密度较小和稀疏的系数布局,包括稀疏指数的存储成本.

blocks.en: During each KV-cache access for attention computation, a Triton kernel fuses residual unpacking, quantization-parameter reconstruction, centroid gathering and PSAC accumulation. Values follow the same reconstruction path without PSAC. The kernel writes only the reconstructed BF16 K/V, which avoids separate dense intermediates for centroid addition and low-rank compensation. The model’s native FlashAttention or SDPA implementation consumes these temporary tensors, which are not retained in the persistent cache. We preserve each model’s native cache layout, attention mask and RoPE convention, where pre-RoPE Keys receive positional encoding after reconstruction, while post-RoPE Keys are reconstructed directly.
blocks.zh: 在每次KV-cache访问以计算注意力时,一个Triton内核引信可进行剩余拆包、量化-参数重建、中间体收集和PSAC积累。 价值没有PSAC遵循同样的重建路径. 内核只写了重建的BF16 K/V,它避免了单独密集的中间体用于中间体加成百分数和低级补偿. 该模型的本土闪存或SDPA执行会消耗这些暂时的抗震器,这些抗震器不保留在持续的缓存中. 我们保存每个模型的本地缓存布局,注意罩和RoPE常规,其中RoPE前键在重建后会得到位置编码,而后RoPE后键则直接重建.

blocks.en: D.2 The Impact of KV Cache Quantization on Latency is Model-dependent
blocks.zh: D.2 KV缓存量化对延迟的影响取决于模型

blocks.en: Although KV cache quantization is mainly designed to reduce memory consumption, its impact on end-to-end latency can vary across different system configurations. Online quantization and cache reconstruction introduce additional computation, while the compressed representation reduces the amount of KV data accessed and transferred during generation. For models that are more constrained by KV-cache memory traffic or cache offloading, the reduction in data movement can outweigh the additional quantization overhead and lead to lower latency. LongCat-Video in Table 6 is such a case, where its native inference pipeline offloads a large KV cache, and QuantWM reduces the amount of cache data repeatedly transferred between host and GPU, which brings lower end-to-end latency. In contrast, when the KV cache is primarily GPU-resident, the reduction in data movement is smaller and the additional quantization operations may introduce a modest latency overhead. Therefore, the latency impact of KV cache quantization depends not only on the compression ratio, but also on how cached representations are accessed and moved during inference.
blocks.zh: 尽管KV缓存量化主要是为减少内存消耗而设计的,但其对端到端间歇性的影响可能因不同的系统配置而异. 在线量化和缓存重建引入了额外的计算,而压缩表达式减少了生成时访问和传输的KV数据的数量. 对于更受KV-cache内存流量或缓存卸载限制的模型,数据移动的减少可以超过额外的定量管理费,导致潜伏性降低. 长 表6中的Cat-Video就是这样的情况,其原生推论管道卸下一个大型的KV缓存,而QuantWM则减少了在主机和GPU之间反复传输的缓存数据数量,这带来了较低的端到端的延迟. 相比之下,当KV缓存主要是GPU-常住时,数据移动的减少较小,额外的量化操作可能引入适度的潜伏性间接费用. 因此,KV缓存量化的延迟影响不仅取决于压缩比,还取决于缓存表达式是如何在推论中访问和移动的.
